action.access-unsupported.remedy: Use "anonymous" or "authenticated". The Kernel does not take "granted" yet.

action.binding-invalid.remedy: Give the binding a source of input with key and type, actor with id or role, kernel with now, or literal with a string or number.

action.binding-nullable-invalid.remedy: Set nullable only on an input binding.

action.count-over.remedy: Declare at most 100 actions in actions.json.

action.key-unknown.remedy: Remove the key, or move it to an action of the kind that takes it.

action.limits-exceeded.remedy: Keep the statement within 20000 bytes and the bindings at 100 or fewer.

action.max-length-invalid.remedy: Set maxLength on a string input to a whole number from 1 to 100000.

action.name-invalid.remedy: Name the action with two or more lowercase words of letters and digits joined by dots, such as orders.list.

action.subscribe-unsupported.remedy: Remove subscribe and poll a query that reads rows after a cursor.

call.auth-invalid.remedy: Give auth a "secret" to sign the request or a "key" to send the API key it holds.

call.bindings-input-only.remedy: Bind only inputs on a call. Bind the actor or the time on its then mutation.

call.body-invalid.remedy: Map at most 32 body keys, each to an input key or to {"value": constant}.

call.body-overlap.remedy: Keep one of the two body paths that overlap.

call.body-path-on-get.remedy: Use a flat body key on GET, or call with POST.

call.body-unbound.remedy: Fill the body key from one of the call's input bindings, or add that input.

call.header-refused.remedy: Send only Idempotency-Key. The Kernel sets every other header.

call.headers-invalid.remedy: Make headers an object that maps Idempotency-Key to an input or a constant.

call.header-unbound.remedy: Fill the header from one of the call's input bindings, or add that input.

call.host-editor.remedy: Call an app or an outside service, not the editor's host.

call.host-ip.remedy: Call a hostname, not an IP address.

call.host-local.remedy: Call a public hostname, not this machine or a cloud metadata service.

call.http-off-installation.remedy: Call with https. Plain http reaches only an app of this installation.

call.keys-on-other-kind.remedy: Set "kind": "call", or remove url, method, body, headers, auth and then.

call.keys-refused.remedy: Remove the statement, signal, guard and http from the call. Put SQL on its then mutation.

call.secret-invalid.remedy: Name the auth secret with lowercase letters, digits and "_", starting with a letter.

call.secret-unset.remedy: The owner sets the secret with secret_set, or in Auth > Integrations, before publishing.

call.signature-header-invalid.remedy: Name a signature header of letters, digits and "-" that the Kernel does not set itself.

call.then-binds-actor.remedy: Name a then mutation that binds no actor. It runs with no caller.

call.then-fills-unknown.remedy: Fill only the then mutation's input keys.

call.then-input-unbound.remedy: Read /input/<key> only for one of the call's input bindings.

call.then-invalid.remedy: Give then a "mutation" and an "input" map of its input keys to JSON pointers into the answer.

call.then-not-mutation.remedy: Name a mutation as the call's then.

call.then-pointer-invalid.remedy: Read a JSON pointer that starts with /ok, /status, /error, /body or /input.

call.then-routed.remedy: Name a then mutation with no http route.

call.then-undeclared.remedy: Declare the then mutation in actions.json, or name one that is declared.

call.then-unfilled.remedy: Fill the input from the answer, or make it nullable on the then mutation.

call.url-invalid.remedy: Use an absolute https:// URL without credentials or a fragment, up to 2048 characters.

connects.invalid.remedy: Make connects in konae.json a list of at most 10 origins.

connects.origin-invalid.remedy: Write the origin as https://host or https://host:port with no path.

connects.origin-twice.remedy: List each origin in connects once.

domain.app-suffix.remedy: Name a hostname outside the installation's app suffix.

domain.installation-host.remedy: Name a hostname no Konae host uses.

domain.ip.remedy: Name a hostname under a domain you control, not an IP address.

domain.local.remedy: Name a hostname under a domain you control, not a local name.

domain.missing.remedy: Name a hostname, such as notes.example.org.

domain.name-invalid.remedy: Use labels of letters, digits and hyphens, 1 to 63 characters each.

domain.one-label.remedy: Name a hostname with at least two labels.

domain.too-long.remedy: Name a hostname of at most 253 characters.

guard.invalid.remedy: Give guard a message of 1 to 200 characters on one line.

guard.not-mutation.remedy: Move the guard to a mutation.

mutation.returning.remedy: Remove RETURNING and read the rows with a query.

mutation.start.remedy: Start a mutation with INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or REPLACE. Tables and indexes belong in schema.sql.

notify.body-invalid.remedy: Write a notify body of 1 to 2000 characters.

notify.changes-in-subject.remedy: Move {changes} to the body; use {changes.count} in the subject.

notify.changes-invalid.remedy: List 1 to 8 column names of the changed table under notify "changes".

notify.changes-undeclared.remedy: Add notify "changes" with the columns {changes} shows.

notify.column-unknown.remedy: Name columns of the table the statement changes, in notify "changes" and "to".

notify.invalid.remedy: Give notify "to", "subject", "body" and an optional "changes" list, and nothing else.

notify.placeholder-unknown.remedy: Use {input.<key>} for one of the action's input bindings, {actor.id}, {kernel.now}, {changes} or {changes.count}.

notify.subject-invalid.remedy: Write a notify subject of 1 to 120 characters on one line.

path.hyphen-edge.remedy: Start and end the path name with a letter or digit.

path.length.remedy: Name a path of 3 to 40 characters.

path.missing.remedy: Name a path, such as spring-menu.

path.name-invalid.remedy: Use only letters, digits and hyphens in the path name.

path.reserved.remedy: Choose a name that Konae does not use for its own addresses.

path.shared-origin.remedy: Set acceptSharedOrigin to true, or leave the path off.

path.taken.remedy: Choose a name that no other app on this installation holds.

path.uuid-shape.remedy: Choose a name that does not have the shape of an app id.

query.limit-missing.remedy: Add a LIMIT to the outer SELECT. A total with no GROUP BY needs none.

query.start.remedy: Start a query with SELECT, and move a WITH clause into a subquery.

route.authenticated.remedy: Remove http, or make the action anonymous and choose its callers.

route.callers-invalid.remedy: List one or more of "signature", "key" and "session" in callers, each once.

route.callers-no-signature.remedy: Declare a signature, or remove "signature" from callers.

route.callers-without-signature.remedy: Add "signature" to callers, or remove the signature.

route.duplicate.remedy: Give each route its own method and path.

route.field-path-invalid.remedy: Write the field as a JSON path, such as "$.data.object.id".

route.field-unbound.remedy: Map only the action's input keys in fields.

route.fields-invalid.remedy: Map 1 to 32 input keys to JSON paths in fields.

route.invalid.remedy: Give http a "method" and a "path", and optionally signature, callers and fields.

route.method-mismatch.remedy: Bind GET on a query and POST on a mutation.

route.path-invalid.remedy: Use a path with a leading "/" and segments of letters, digits, ".", "_", "~" or "-".

route.signature-secret-call-only.remedy: The owner sets a route secret with a value of its own, with secret_set or in Auth > Integrations.

route.signature-secret-unset.remedy: The owner sets the secret with secret_set, or in Auth > Integrations, before publishing.

route.signature-svix-secret-invalid.remedy: The owner sets the secret to the whsec_ value the provider shows, with secret_set or in Auth > Integrations.

schedule.daily-invalid.remedy: Write daily as HH:MM in UTC, from 00:00 to 23:59.

schedule.input.remedy: Bind only actor, kernel and literal values on a scheduled mutation.

schedule.invalid.remedy: Declare "every" with minutes or hours, such as "15m", or "daily" with a UTC time.

schedule.not-mutation.remedy: Move the schedule to a mutation.

schedule.too-often.remedy: Run every 5 minutes or less often.

schedule.too-rare.remedy: Use "daily" or a period of 24 hours or less.

schema.check-names-removed-column.remedy: Keep the column in schema.ts, or rebuild the table without that CHECK in the SQL console, then apply the migration again.

schema.model-differs-from-database.remedy: Apply the migration that brings the database to the accepted model with database_execute apply-migration or in Data, or restore a backup taken under that model, then publish again.

schema.model-not-accepted.remedy: Apply the planned migration with database_execute apply-migration or in Data, or put schema.ts back to the accepted model, then publish again.

schema.no-changes.remedy: Change a table or column in schema.ts, then plan the migration again.

schema.statement-refused.remedy: Keep only CREATE TABLE and CREATE INDEX in schema.sql. Rows change through mutations.

secret.google-id-looks-like-secret.remedy: Paste the client ID, which ends with .apps.googleusercontent.com, and put the GOCSPX- value in google_client_secret.

secret.google-names-only.remedy: Name a secret with use google google_client_id or google_client_secret.

secret.google-names-reserved.remedy: Set google_client_id and google_client_secret with use google, or leave use out.

secret.google-still-on.remedy: Turn Google off with sign_in_methods_set methods ["password"], or in Auth > Users, then delete the secret.

secret.value-invalid.remedy: Paste a value of 16 to 512 printable ASCII characters without spaces.

signal.invalid.remedy: Give signal a "name" and optionally a "properties" list of input keys.

signal.missing.remedy: Declare a signal on the signal action.

signal.name-invalid.remedy: Name the signal with dot-separated lowercase words, such as "order.placed".

signal.on-query.remedy: Move the signal to a mutation or to a "kind": "signal" action.

signal.property-unbound.remedy: Name only the action's input keys, or actor, as signal properties.

signal.route.remedy: Remove http, or declare the signal on a mutation with a POST route.

signal.statement.remedy: Remove the statement from the signal action.

signin.google-client-unset.remedy: Set google_client_id and google_client_secret with secret_set use google, or in Auth > Users, then turn Google on.

signature.algorithm-invalid.remedy: Set the signature algorithm to "sha256" or "sha1".

signature.encoding-invalid.remedy: Set the signature encoding to "hex" or "base64".

signature.header-invalid.remedy: Name a signature header of letters, digits and "-" that the Kernel does not set itself.

signature.keys-invalid.remedy: Keep only the keys the signature's scheme takes.

signature.prefix-invalid.remedy: Use a signature prefix of 1 to 32 letters, digits, "=", "-", "_", "." or ":".

signature.provider-extra-keys.remedy: Keep only "provider" and "secret" in a provider signature.

signature.provider-on-get.remedy: Bind POST, or use the konae scheme on GET.

signature.provider-unknown.remedy: Name a provider the Kernel knows, or write the long form.

signature.secret-invalid.remedy: Name the signature secret with lowercase letters, digits and "_", starting with a letter.

signature.tag-invalid.remedy: Set the signature tag to the field's name and "=", such as "v1=".

signature.timestamp-prefix-invalid.remedy: Set the timestamp prefix to the field's name and "=", such as "t=".

signature.window-invalid.remedy: Set the signature window to a whole number of seconds from 1 to 3600.

statement.several.remedy: Put one SQL statement in the action.
